intro: Uruguay is a land of rolling grasslands, beaches and rivers.

chapters.title: Land
text: Gentle hills and grassland, called pampas, cover most of the country. The Río de la Plata estuary and Atlantic beaches like Punta del Este line the south and east.

chapters.title: Climate
text: The climate is mild, with warm summers and cool winters.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Uruguay's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
